question: Should `/v1/chat/completions` expose internal OpenClaw agent tool calls, or should its `tool_calls` response remain limited to caller-supplied HTTP client tools?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally describe a client-tool contract, while expanding it to internal tools would change a public API surface and a sensitive operator telemetry boundary.

options.title: Keep Chat tool_calls client-only
options.body: Treat internal tool telemetry as unsupported for Chat Completions and clarify docs or support guidance around the existing client-tool contract.

options.title: Design separate diagnostic trace API
options.body: Expose redacted internal tool lifecycle through a distinct opt-in trace or diagnostic surface with explicit scopes, retention, and tests.

options.title: Expand Chat Completions semantics
options.body: Map internal OpenClaw tool calls into Chat Completions `tool_calls` only after defining compatibility, redaction, and follow-up-loop behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Chat tool_calls client-only
recommendation.body: Treat internal tool telemetry as unsupported for Chat Completions and clarify docs or support guidance around the existing client-tool contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the original OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint and the API/security boundary that this product decision would change.
